components.summary: Chooses the layer that the block uses. The layer decides how the game draws the block and whether the block is solid.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: A block with kurblanc:wall defaults to wall. All other blocks default to floor.

components.behavior: An unknown value fails when the game registers the world content. Objects must set "object" explicitly.

components.summary: Sets the fallback color for previews, break particles and light when you give no light color.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Six hex digits. The game rejects shorthand and named colors.

components.behavior: A value that is not #rrggbb fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Sets the display name for the block and for an item that places it.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Optional.

components.behavior: The game stores a non-string value as-is. Keep it a string.

components.summary: Chooses the sound set that the game uses to place, break and step on the block.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The active asset pack must supply the set.

components.behavior: A name that is not lower_snake_case fails while the parser reads the block.

components.summary: Allows or forbids placing this block from an item.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The open state of a door or gate sets this to false. The closed state is placeable.

components.behavior: kurblanc:placeable must be a boolean. An open toggle state must set it to false.

components.summary: Makes a raised block solid or walk-through.

fields.name: value
fields.default: true on wall and object layers, false on floor
fields.notes: Floor blocks cannot be solid.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails when the game registers the world content. The game rejects a solid floor.

components.summary: Gives a raised block a collision box that is smaller than its tile.

fields.name: box
fields.range: origin -32 to 64, positive size, box inside 64×64
fields.notes: Tile-local pixels.

fields.name: verticalBox
fields.notes: The game uses it for a vertical face.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Keeps neighbor footprints aligned.

fields.name: verticalMasks
fields.notes: Cardinal masks that use verticalBox.

components.behavior: Out-of-bounds rectangles, a floor block or a bad mask fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Draws an object-facing sprite that turns with the camera.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Meaningful only on the object layer.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Sets how much light the block absorbs.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: A value of 0 is fully transparent. A value of 15 stops light.

components.behavior: A value outside 0–15 or a non-integer fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Sets the mining time and the tools that speed it up. It also names the tools that the block needs.

fields.name: seconds_to_destroy
fields.notes: The game converts it to game ticks.

fields.name: preferred_tool
fields.notes: A matching tool mines at its own speed.

fields.name: required_tool
fields.notes: You cannot harvest the block without that tool kind and tier.

components.behavior: A bad mining field fails while the parser reads the block. The game accepts false and keeps the default mining time.

components.summary: Points at a loot table instead of an inline drop list.

fields.name: table
fields.notes: You cannot combine it with kurblanc:drops.

components.behavior: A missing table or a definition that also holds kurblanc:drops fails.

components.summary: Lists the items that a successful break can produce.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Each entry rolls independently. Omit chance for a guaranteed drop.

components.behavior: A non-array, an unknown item or a chance outside 0–1 fails.

components.summary: Makes the block a light source.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The game ignores 0 or less and leaves the block unlit.

components.behavior: A value above 15 fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Tints the light that the block emits.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The game uses it only with kurblanc:light_emission.

components.behavior: A value that is not #rrggbb fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Chooses the primary texture of the block and an optional wall-front texture. Use a PNG path or a key in terrain_texture.json from an active AP.

fields.name: * or up.texture
fields.range: a path under textures/ (or a texture key)
fields.notes: The primary face. Point at a PNG under textures/, or at a key in AP/textures/terrain_texture.json.

fields.name: * or up.rect
fields.notes: Crops one sprite from a packed sheet.

fields.name: front.texture
fields.range: a path under textures/ (or a texture key)
fields.notes: The front face of a wall. It is separate from the top texture.

fields.name: *.cell
fields.notes: For a direct PNG path, declares the cell size of a horizontal variant strip. Frames have one-pixel gaps. For a texture key, declare cell in terrain_texture.json instead. Do not combine strips and crop rectangles.

components.behavior: A missing primary texture fails while the game resolves content. A path that no active asset pack supplies also fails.

components.summary: Recolors grayscale art with the color of the biome that the tile stands in.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The art must use neutral gray for the tint to read correctly.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails while the parser reads the block.

components.summary: Marks a floor block as natural ground with corner tiling and optional rotation.

fields.name: random_rotate
fields.notes: Rotates each tile from a stable hash.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Ground of the same group connects.

fields.name: substrate
fields.notes: The material that the game shows under the surface.

fields.name: tint
fields.notes: A fixed color multiply for the art.

fields.name: biome_tint
fields.notes: Same as the top-level component when that is absent.

components.behavior: Bad field types fail while the parser reads the block or when the game registers content.

components.summary: Marks a floor block as a built surface that connects in 47 shapes.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Surfaces of the same group connect.

components.behavior: The texture must use the surface sheet layout. The game does not slice an arbitrary image.

components.summary: Marks a block as a wall and sets the height of its raised top.

fields.name: lift
fields.notes: Top elevation in source pixels.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Walls of the same group connect.

components.behavior: A lift outside 0–32 fails when the game registers the world content.

components.summary: Turns a floor block into water with a visible bed underneath.

fields.name: bed
fields.notes: The game shows it where the water is shallow or exposed.

fields.name: opacity
fields.notes: Water tint strength, not the 0–15 light opacity.

components.behavior: A missing bed or an opacity outside the open range fails while the parser reads the block.

components.summary: Describes a raised sprite: crop, offset, depth, shadow and variants.

fields.name: height
fields.notes: Visual height only. Collision stays on the tile footprint.

fields.name: rect
fields.notes: Crops the sprite from its sheet.

fields.name: sprite_offset
fields.notes: Moves the sprite relative to the tile.

fields.name: depth
fields.notes: Draw order against floors.

fields.name: vertical_depth
fields.notes: Draw order against walls.

fields.name: vertical_rect
fields.notes: An alternate crop for a vertical face.

fields.name: vertical_offset
fields.notes: The offset for the vertical crop.

fields.name: vertical_masks
fields.notes: Cardinal masks that use the vertical crop.

fields.name: shadow
fields.notes: Projects the alpha of the sprite instead of a box.

fields.name: contact_shadow
fields.notes: The root-contact ellipse.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Keeps neighbor sprites sorted together.

fields.name: random_flip
fields.notes: Mirrors from a stable tile hash.

fields.name: sway
fields.notes: Adds ambient movement to foliage.

fields.name: variant_weights
fields.range: one positive weight per strip frame
fields.notes: Declare the cell of the strip on the material instance.

fields.name: foliage
fields.notes: canopyEnd is greater than 0 and less than 1. leafTextures holds 1–32 keys.

fields.name: tint
fields.notes: A fixed color multiply for the sprite.

fields.name: biome_tint
fields.notes: Same as the top-level component when that is absent.

fields.name: biome_tint_scale
fields.notes: Darkens a sprite that has a biome tint.

components.behavior: Bad rectangle sizes, masks, shadow values or tint colors fail while the parser reads the block.

components.summary: Makes a floor block take part in buildable terrain fill or cover.

fields.name: mode
fields.notes: fill forms the ground mass. The game applies cover on top.

fields.name: face
fields.notes: Allowed only on fill, for the exposed edge.

components.behavior: Terrain on anything but a floor, or face on cover, fails when the game registers content.

components.summary: Lets one object sit on another, such as a ladder attached to a wall.

fields.name: down
fields.notes: How many levels down the support can be.

components.behavior: A non-object link, an extra field or a level outside 1–16 fails.

components.summary: Groups matching door or gate leaves so they open and close together.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Both halves use the same value. Both halves need a kurblanc:toggle.

components.behavior: Fails registration with: blocks: (block id).pair needs matching object toggle states. Pair is only valid on object-layer toggles.

components.summary: Names the other state of a two-file door or gate.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The closed file points at the open file. The open file points back at the closed file.

components.behavior: Fails registration with: blocks: (block id).toggle must reference a block on the same layer.

components.summary: Turns one block file into a closed/open door pair.

fields.name: closed
fields.range: texture path, or an object with texture and optional art overrides
fields.notes: The placed state. A string names its texture. An object can add rect, sprite_offset, vertical_rect, vertical_offset, vertical_masks, height, depth, vertical_depth, footprint and label.

fields.name: open
fields.range: texture path, or an object with texture and optional art overrides
fields.notes: The generated open state. It takes the same fields as closed. The game forces placeable, collision and opacity off.

components.behavior: The loader generates (id)_open, cross-links kurblanc:toggle, and forces the open state non-placeable, non-solid and opacity 0. The closed state must be placeable and the layer must be object. Do not add a second _open file.
